title: x-gurps annotation vocabulary
description: Defines the custom annotation keywords used by gurps-character.schema.json. Validators that do not know these keywords can ignore them; tools that do (e.g. Ajv addKeyword with these metaSchemas) can validate them.

role.description: input: entered by the player. derived: always equals its formula. overridable: formula gives the default, a different stored value is a deliberate override (e.g. bought-up HP). state: changes during play (current HP/FP).

formula.description: Expression in the language described in schema/README.md.

default.description: Value assumed when the property is absent.

costPerLevel.description: Character points per level above/below the base.

reference.description: Page in the GURPS 4e Basic Set (Módulo Básico).

sheetField.description: Field id(s) in the original PDF sheet / web app layout; {n} marks row numbers.

label.description: Localized display labels keyed by BCP 47 tag (English is the schema title/key).

mode.description: map: exact key. step: value of the largest key <= lookup key; null below the first key.

extrapolate.description: Above `from`: value(from) + floor((key - from) / every) * add (for dice, add is a dice count).
